name: Shopify
tagline: Public distribution · App Store review · Protected customer data
verdict: Custom distribution covers only one store or one Plus organization, so serving arbitrary merchants needs public App Store review, a registration fee, the billing API and compliance webhooks. Duration is not stated; plan several weeks.
needGuide: Yes. Public distribution has a long checklist: App Store review, compliance webhooks, the Billing API and protected customer data access.

auth.detail: Embedded apps use the token exchange grant (App Bridge ID token to access token); non-embedded apps use the authorization code grant; managed installation (scopes declared in shopify.app.toml) is the default for CLI-built apps. Offline tokens are per store. Expiring offline tokens last 1 hour with a 90-day refresh token (rotating); public apps must use expiring tokens for the GraphQL Admin API by 2027-01-01 (new public apps cannot use non-expiring ones). Per-shop URLs ({shop}.myshopify.com).

effort.timeToProduction: Unknown; review duration is not stated in official docs. Plan several weeks including resubmissions.

approval.gate: Creating apps, dev stores and custom-distribution apps is self-serve, but custom distribution only covers one store or stores in one Plus organization. Serving arbitrary other merchants needs public distribution: Shopify App Store review (automated checks, then human review), a one-time registration fee, the Shopify Billing API for any charges, compliance webhooks, and protected customer data access (Level 1, or Level 2 for name/email/phone/address, with possible data protection review).
approval.when: Serving arbitrary merchants needs public distribution, which needs Shopify App Store review: automated checks, then human review.

timeline.label: Human review
timeline.official: Duration not stated in official docs

scopes.why: Customer data needs protected customer data Level 1, and name, email, phone or address need Level 2; both are checked at App Store review.

table.note: Request only what the app uses
Request it in the app's API access requests
Possible data protection review; unapproved fields are redacted

cost: Free to build and test. Public listing: a one-time App Store registration fee (amount not on the fetched pages; commonly cited as US$19, verify) plus Shopify revenue share on app billing.

tiers.label: Custom distribution
tiers.eg: One store or one Plus organization
tiers.note: Self-serve, but it only reaches one store or the stores of one Plus organization.

tiers.label: Public distribution (App Store)
tiers.note: App Store review, a one-time registration fee, the Billing API for charges and mandatory compliance webhooks.

prerequisites: A company-owned Shopify ID that owns the Dev Dashboard organization and has app development access, not a personal login.
Free development stores for testing (no real payments).
The Shopify CLI (shopify app init, shopify app dev).
For the listing: a 1200×1200 icon, an English screencast, test credentials, an emergency contact and a privacy policy.
Budget for the one-time App Store registration fee (commonly cited as US$19; verify).

registerAt.path: Dev Dashboard → Apps → Create app (or shopify app init); then set Distribution = Public on the production app (it can't be changed later). Protected customer data: app → API access requests → Protected customer data access → Request access.

steps.do: Create a company-owned Shopify ID and Dev Dashboard organization.
Scaffold the app with shopify app init, set distribution to Public on the production app, and keep a separate dev app.
Declare scopes in shopify.app.toml and rely on managed installation. Implement token exchange (embedded) or the authorization code grant (standalone) with expiring=1 and refresh-token handling.
Implement the mandatory compliance webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact) and use only the GraphQL Admin API.
Request protected customer data access in the app's API access requests, with a reason per field and data protection details.
Install on a dev store and run end-to-end tests, including uninstall and reinstall and token refresh.
Prepare the listing: 1200×1200 icon, English screencast, test credentials, emergency contact and privacy policy. Run the automated checks.
Pay the registration fee and submit to App Store review. Answer reviewer email from noreply@shopify.com.

roles.team: A company-owned Shopify ID that owns the Dev Dashboard organization and has app development access. Use one org-level owner, not a personal login, since distribution and the app listing belong to the org.
roles.console: Dev Dashboard documents two permissions: app development access and View financials. Org settings hold users and payout/billing (replaces the Partner Dashboard); the exact add-user path is not confirmed.
roles.customer: Store owner or staff with permission to install apps approves the scopes on install. Unapproved protected-customer-data fields come back redacted for public apps.

consoleRoles.can: Build and manage the organization's apps in the Dev Dashboard.
See payouts and billing for the organization.

customerExperience: A store owner, or staff with permission to install apps, approves the scopes at install.
Unapproved protected-customer-data fields come back redacted for public apps.
testing: Free development stores via the Dev Dashboard; shopify app dev tunnels.
Apps installed only on dev stores can read protected customer data without review (after the access-request form is filled).
No real payments on dev stores.

blockers.problem: The distribution method can't be changed once chosen
blockers.fix: Create the production app as Public from the start.

blockers.problem: Non-expiring offline tokens stop working for public-app GraphQL Admin calls after 2027-01-01
blockers.fix: Use expiring tokens, and never refresh and re-acquire at the same time for one store.

blockers.problem: Missing compliance webhooks, off-platform billing or REST Admin API use cause review rejection
blockers.fix: Fix them before submitting: repeated failures trigger a submission cooldown.

blockers.problem: Unapproved protected customer data fields are redacted (GraphQL returns HTTP 200 with an error)
blockers.fix: Request access before testing against real merchants.

gotchas: Embedded apps use token exchange (App Bridge ID token to access token); non-embedded apps use the authorization code grant.
Expiring offline tokens last 1 hour with a rotating 90-day refresh token.
Tokens are per store, on per-shop URLs ({shop}.myshopify.com).

automation.agentCan: Write the token-exchange/refresh code, shopify.app.toml scopes, compliance webhook handlers, GraphQL queries and test calls, and draft listing copy, data-protection answers and screencast scripts.
automation.humanMust: Create and own the Shopify ID/org, accept Partner agreements, pay the registration fee, record the screencast, submit for review, and handle reviewer correspondence.
